ops.why: The tree-minder keeps the offerings at the foot of the tree filled and the candles trimmed.

The house the remaining children and grandparents share; they sleep on its hay nests.

ops.text: walk 12 close-out: the five west-cluster houses (smith, reed, net, cane, dyer) carried only a door light; each gets the village store or net group on a scanned pose, as the east houses already have.

walk 12 close-out (R127): a drying rack at the lane end of the elder's step carries the lodging board under its crossbar, so it is read from the lane. The HTBM washline post is not licensed outside by its plugin (setting.class). A bare Kothringi pole has no beam for a board.
16x reds: the drying rack gives no solid seat, so the board hangs on its own arm from the elder house wall, 2.4 m up on the lane side.
walk 12 close-out: moved to the west side of the trade step, clear of the pad that seats sp-trade.
walk 12 close-out (R127): a drying rack beside the lane end of the trade step carries the trade board.
16x reds: the drying rack gives no solid seat, so the board hangs on its own arm from the trade hut, on the side that faces the lane.

walk 12 close-out: moved 1 m further from the door, clear of the eave, still within the 4 m of the walls that serviceSignRule asks; board turned 90 degrees to the rack so its face looks down the lane.

ops.text: walk 12 W2 part 2: feature 1, the canoe beach: the village's canoes drawn up on the bank north of the landing, clear of the reeds (fl-reed4/5).
walk 12 W2 part 2: feature 2, the drying way: fish and cane leaf hung to dry along the houses lane between the two halves of the village (dressing.md 7).

walk 12 W2 part 3: houses lane dressing, so a walker sees a lane in daily use: baskets at the doors and at the trade end, a woven screen and a fence by the yards; a second drying rack (the village smokes fish on racks; no smoke-house mesh is in the pool).
walk 12 W2 part 2: feature 3, the bend markers: a carved post at the west end of the lane and marker poles (ft-pole1-3) along it, one for each bend the village counts on the way to the tree.
16x reds: hung beside the door frame, not in the doorway, so a walker passes under it into the hut.
